strand_b.summary: Through a comparative analysis of two policy-focused cases, the UK Government Office for Science’s Net Zero Society: Scenarios and Pathways report and the JRC’s Policy Lab and the ESPAS Horizon Scanning exercise, we develop a conceptual framework based on three enablers that enhance SF’s evidential value: robustness, appropriateness, and inclusivity. Strategic foresight as a source of evidence for policymaking. Abstract This article examines the integration of strategic foresight (SF) as a source of evidence for policymaking.

strand_b.title: Macrohistorical Cycle Synchronization as a Method for Long‐Range Foresight: The Ten Mega Epochs Model
strand_b.summary: This article introduces macrohistorical cycle synchronization as a foresight methodology for analysing such deep‐time transformations. The method extends strategic foresight beyond near‐term trend analysis toward a science of long‐range anticipation, linking techno‐social‐economical transformation, institutional evolution, and civilisational renewal in a single temporal framework.
